payload.title: Punch-line and caption edge cases left from PR 44 review
payload.description: Low items from the review of PR 44, none blocking. (1) _sentence_can_be_punchline excludes closers ending in straight or curly double quotes but not the curly right single quote U+2019. (2) A capitalised attribution after a quoted question ('...?' Ryan asked.) still splits and the attribution reads as a terse closer. (3) _check_punchline_cadence computes prose spans on masked text, so an image paragraph vanishes and a multi-sentence italic caption after it is treated as prose for cadence only; computing is_markup on raw text would make intent, opening-screen and cadence agree. (4) The image-plus-caption fixture joins them with one newline, so the follows_markup caption branch has no scenario; add one with a blank line between image and caption.
